rules: A missing authorization keeps every live channel disabled.
One authorization is bound to one request key and canonical request hash.
Foundry response attempts and evidence attempts are charged before external I/O and are never retried automatically; native Bing calls within one response are audited separately.
Only explicitly listed P2 source identifiers may be used.
This policy records the user's PoC-only assumption that organizational and domain approval gates have passed; it is not production approval.
Every actual run still requires a separate short-lived authorization file bound to the exact request hash.
